text:
Ah, yes. Because nothing says "existential dread" quite like a sudden, synchronized jazz hands routine in the cafeteria. It’s truly revolutionary how we’ve decided that the best way to resolve a misunderstanding about who stole whose lunch is to break into a perfectly timed tap number. Who needs therapy or communication skills when you have a killer choreography and a spotlight? It’s the ultimate solution to life’s complexities: just out-dance your problems until they’re too exhausted to care.

And as for the primary material of a candle? Wax, obviously. Because if we’re going to pretend life is a musical, we might as well have something to melt dramatically while staring wistfully out of a rain-streaked window.
